text.text_excerpt: Tucked away in an alley way of the French Quarter is the lair of the Dungeon!! This place was such a solace for me considering that I listen to metal music. (death, black, thrash metal etc.) So whenever I find places I love it. After spending a couple of hours on Bourbon St. listening to what's hot of pop music and listening to cover bands I needed a break from all of that and needed to rock out to some metal!!! \m/ This place might scare some people and make them uncomfortable, and I understand that, it's not for everyone. Just like I can't go to nightclubs because they make me uncomfortable, heh. I can't wait until June when I head back to NOLA and get to rock out again!!!

Ok this place is awsome. Nice staff Cool stuff to look at. Drink and shoot pool. Went there on a thur and they had a special 3 PBR pitchers , not my favorite beer but i guess it will do. Well compared to everything else in the neighborhood extremely over priced this place was a treat. The second bar upstairs past the courtyard was also pretty neat, try the signature midnight potion drink, it just might get you messed up . Will def stop by that bar everytime im in new orleans. In that neighborhood its somtimes nice to get to listen to some rock music at the bar.

"The Dungeon" has been my favorite bar in Nawlins for over 30yrs... you start out going thru a a creepy door thru a very narrow stone walkway into a courtyard... when you are greeted by security opening another door for you to walk thru... i usually sit in the little booth at the end of the bar downstairs bar listening to the jukebox and watching the endless amount of interesting caricatures walking thru there... i just love people watching... I really want to give The Dungeon 5 stars but its changed a bit in the past few years so here are my top three reasons I am disappointed... 1.
